summary: Patient Self-Service Portal end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 18/18 patient_portal pytest cases passed (issue/list/revoke + 6 public endpoints + privacy scrub + bad/short/expired/revoked token paths + receptionist 403 boundary). Frontend smoke: (a) /p/{freshly-issued-token} renders PatientPortal with data-testid=patient-portal-page, Seal of Privacy badge present (data-testid=seal-of-privacy-badge), section testids verified (portal-medications, portal-prescriptions, portal-notes, portal-past rendered; portal-upcoming/portal-payments empty as expected), zero console errors. (b) /appointments/:id Health Records tab renders IssuePortalLinkCard (data-testid=issue-portal-link-card); clicking issue-link-btn fires POST /api/patient-portal/issue-link, shows toast 'Portal link issued', renders full URL (data-testid=generated-link) and copy button (data-testid=copy-link-btn). Combined regression of patient_portal + consultation_notes_and_health + medication_reminders + prescription_phase1 = 61/61 passed (after fixing pymongo URI parsing in expired-token test).
action_items: (No action) Note for next testing agent: /auth/login is rate-limited to 5/minute. If running large multi-module suites that all log in fresh, add a sleep or share a session-scoped login fixture across files to avoid 429.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/patient_portal.py — clean separation between owner endpoints (require_doctor_or_owner) and public endpoints (no Depends), correct 404/410 semantics in _resolve_token, PRIVATE_FIELDS={'private_doctor_notes','private_notes'} scrubbed in prescriptions and consultation-notes responses (verified in payload + raw text). TTL clamping max(1, min(180, ttl_days)) verified at both bounds.
Tokens generated via secrets.token_urlsafe(24) (32+ chars URL-safe) — good entropy; len<16 short-circuit on _resolve_token prevents trivial enumeration.
Revoke uses owner_id filter in update query so a doctor cannot revoke another doctor's token (returns 404 — verified by test_revoke_unknown_token_404).
All public endpoints exclude _id via {'_id':0} projection; payments endpoint also strips razorpay_signature and razorpay_key_secret — good defensive posture.

Frontend PatientPortal.js uses bare axios.get (no Authorization interceptor injected because axios default instance is used, and no global header was set since user isn't logged in). Verified by inspection + console-error free render.

Suggestion (non-blocking): list_links endpoint returns all tokens including revoked ones; consider a query flag ?active_only=true for the doctor UI. Currently no doctor-side list UI consumes this, so OK for now.
Suggestion (non-blocking): expires_at is stored as ISO string and parsed at read time. Acceptable, but storing a native datetime and using TTL index would let MongoDB auto-purge expired tokens.
